_about: Public demo: the Automations ring in the Second Brain. refresh/sources/automations.cjs reads scheduled tasks and Claude hooks live. The demo lists no scheduled tasks; hooks show up only if the demo home folder has a .claude/settings.json whose hook commands contain one of the 'match' words. The desktop routines below always move to this ring. 'learns' = it rewrites skills, knowledge, memory or agent instructions. Paths in 'writes' and 'watchedRoots' are relative to the kit folder.

backup-check.desc: Nightly: checks that every project repo has a fresh backup and that last week's restore test passed. Reports only, never deletes.

brain-refresh.desc: Every 3 hours: rebuilds the Second Brain map, the skills list and the home orb. No model calls.

skill-review.desc: Mondays: reads the week's skill gotchas and lessons and proposes skill edits for approval. Never edits a skill on its own.

lesson-capture.desc: After a session ends: offers a one-line lesson for memory/lessons when a fix took more than one try.

skill-gotcha-check.desc: At session start: shows the gotchas of the skills the task is likely to use.

ring-publish.desc: After an HTML page is written: adds it to the HQ ring with a sidecar.
